key_insight: Yalda-Embedding improves compact Persian retrieval through relational knowledge distillation, achieving the highest macro-average among evaluated 0.6B models without increasing inference-time model size.
engineering_relevance: Released weights, code, training pairs, and teacher embeddings support reproducible Persian retrieval development while avoiding repeated teacher-inference costs.
method: Adapt Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B using over one million Persian query-document pairs.
Study contrastive batch size and optimization stabilization through incremental ablations.
Apply relational knowledge distillation from F2LLM-v2-8B without explicitly mined or supplied hard negatives.
evidence_signal: Across eight FaMTEB Persian retrieval tasks, distillation raises the macro-average from 0.4813 to 0.5488, improving every task over the non-distilled model and finishing 0.0075 behind Qwen3-Embedding-4B.
watch_item: Evidence is limited to eight Persian retrieval benchmarks and a one-epoch training setup; broader domain generalization remains unestablished.
paper_title: Yalda-Embedding: Open Development of a Competitive Persian Retrieval Model
